description: Arceaux Vélos is a dataset listed in Opendata de la Ville de Liège open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données permet de visualiser les emplacements des arceaux vélos gérés par la Ville de Liège ainsi que le nombre de places associées. Il existe différents types d’arceaux dont l'apparence et le nombre de places différent. Pour en savoir plus, consultez le jeu de données Types arceaux vélos. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace public. Its keywords are vélo, mobilité, parking, stationnement, mobilité douce. The portal shows 746 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-liege-be-portal.
